contributions.what: Monthly marketing plan drafted, reviewed by the CEO seat and sent to the founder for one-shot approval on the 1st
One SEO/GEO article a week, released only on the founder's approval on a UAE working day
Monthly answer-engine (GEO) prompt panel: are we cited, by which engine, and what to fix
contributions.gap: Checks run (24 checked in Oct) but 0 citations and no recorded fix action per uncited question; findings are not turned into content or entity fixes.

contributions.what: Supplier recruitment plan per thin trade: ranked by gap and demand, where its suppliers gather, an English invitation variant
Supplier acquisition funnel analytics per recruit gap (invited, registered, verified, quoting) with diagnosis
contributions.gap: Last result shows funnel totals all null (pool, invited, registered, quoting); stage conversion is not actually measured from delivered invitations.

contributions.what: Competitor watch: home and pricing pages, social posts, material changes raised to the CEO, weekly brief
contributions.gap: 36 competitors watched but the scan requests and collects 0 pages and sees 0 social posts; the weekly brief is built on no data.

contributions.what: Reputation: ask every revealed customer for a public review 3 weeks after reveal, daily review snapshot, reply to reviews
contributions.gap: waiting_for_link: true and asks_sent 0 - the Google review link is not configured, so no review is ever requested.

contributions.what: January 2027 launch plan redrawn from category readiness, organic only until every category is open, sent for approval from 1 December
Monthly self-review against the qualification exam and senior checklist, opening the seat's own improvements
Publish the approved social calendar natively per platform (LinkedIn, Instagram/Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X) on working days, with UTM links
contributions.gap: No seat_duty publishes or schedules social posts; posting is not automated or tracked as a duty.

contributions.what: Community management: classify and answer comments and DMs within 1-2 working hours, route leads and complaints
contributions.gap: No marketing seat_duty owns the social inbox; the audit found fn:marketing_social_inbox failing about half its runs with no owner duty.

contributions.what: Weekly trend scan (TikTok Creative Center, Google Trends UAE, regulatory news) with a 48-hour accept/reject decision
contributions.gap: No duty collects or decides on trends.

contributions.what: Monthly marketing scorecard: suppliers registered per campaign, cost per registered supplier, GEO citations, share of voice, post performance by pillar
contributions.gap: No duty produces the KPI scorecard; KPIs exist only in knowledge entries.

contributions.what: Fact register kept in sync: a changed fee or policy updates every page, schema, llms.txt and profile the same day
contributions.gap: No duty watches canonical facts and re-publishes or requests recrawl when one changes.

contributions.what: Ad-spend reporting to the accountant and paid campaigns once a budget is approved (creative tests, pacing, kill line)
contributions.gap: Paid is correctly gated off (paid_allowed false); there is no duty yet that runs, paces or reports paid spend once approved.
